As of 2024, the retraction remains fully in effect, and the paper is marked as retracted in all major academic databases including PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and the AACR's official publication platform. A small subset of co-authors did not initially endorse the retraction, but no appeal has overturned the decision in the years since it was issued.
